faqs.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.description: Still unsure? Our support team is here to answer your questions and guide you every step of the way.
faqs.faq_a_1: Trading - buying and selling in financial markets - is a modern phenomenon and a fundamental economic activity that has evolved over centuries. At its core, trading involves exchanging goods, stocks, forex, and cryptocurrencies with the goal of profiting from market price fluctuations. Unlike investing, which often focuses on long-term growth, trading benefits from short-term market movements.
faqs.faq_q_2: How long does it take to master trading?
faqs.faq_a_2: There is no set time for mastering trading, but based on the educational plan we provide, we estimate that it takes students between 6 to 9 months to acquire the necessary skills and knowledge. Professional mastery, however, depends entirely on personal market experience (market analysis calls with the expert are crucial for skill development).
faqs.faq_q_3: How long does it take to complete the education?
faqs.faq_a_3: The world of trading is vast, so the amount of information you can acquire is tremendous, and it doesn't depend on time because you'll learn something new every day, even over years. However, our educational plan estimates two days per lesson: one for watching and one for applying and correcting.
faqs.faq_a_4: It's deceptively difficult. Trading is one of the most challenging fields a person can choose to enter, but if mastered, it can be life-changing. Unlike what you see on social media, trading is not just a strategy or a chart; it's much broader and more comprehensive.
faqs.faq_q_5: When will I start making money from trading?
faqs.faq_a_5: It's better to ask this question differently: Can I stop losing? The answer is after training on a demo (simulated) account and when your coach sees that you're following a set risk management plan. The coach will then decide when you can start trading on a live account and begin making money with a specific risk management strategy.
faqs.faq_q_6: Does your academy provide comprehensive education from beginner to expert?
faqs.faq_a_6: Yes, the academy offers education that starts from Forex basics, moves on to classical technical analysis, then economic and fundamental analysis, followed by liquidity analysis, and concludes with weekly market analysis to complete the professional training program.
faqs.faq_q_7: Are there any monthly subscription fees?
faqs.faq_a_7: There are no fees for education; it's a one-time payment, and weekly analysis is provided for one month. After that, monthly payment is required to continue receiving weekly analysis and market insights.
faqs.faq_q_8: Can I learn at any time?
faqs.faq_a_8: Yes, the calls are recorded, and students can learn at any time they wish.
faqs.faq_q_9: Why do most traders lose at the beginning?
faqs.faq_a_9: One of the fundamental principles of trading is risk management, which we focus on in our educational curriculum. It can reduce losses and increase the chances of profit.
faqs.faq_q_10: What is the minimum capital I can start trading with?
faqs.faq_a_10: No one can set your capital, but you can ask yourself what daily profit you're satisfied with in the Forex market, aiming for 1-3% of your capital.
